message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, each coin can land either heads (H) or tails (T).  
The total number of equally‑likely outcomes is \(2^3 = 8\).

**Possible numbers of heads**

| # of heads | Number of ways | Probability |
|------------|----------------|-------------|
| 0          | 1 (TTT)        | \(1/8 = 12.5\%\) |
| 1          | 3 (HTT, THT, TTH) | \(3/8 = 37.5\%\) |
| 2          | 3 (HHT, HTH, THH) | \(3/8 = 37.5\%\) |
| 3          | 1 (HHH)        | \(1/8 = 12.5\%\) |

So after tossing three coins you can obtain **0, 1, 2, or 3 heads**. The probabilities above show how likely each outcome is.
